mkdir -p zoom
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
items=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]
print('items',len(items))
for start in range(0,len(items),5):
 rows=[]
 for i,it in enumerate(items[start:start+5],start):
  w=Image.open(it['word_image']).convert('RGB'); l=Image.open(it['line_image']).convert('RGB')
  row=Image.new('RGB',(max(1500,w.width,l.width),w.height+l.height+45),'white'); d=ImageDraw.Draw(row); d.text((5,5),str(i+1)+' '+it['item_id'],fill='black'); row.paste(w,(0,25)); row.paste(l,(0,w.height+35)); rows.append(row)
 sheet=Image.new('RGB',(max(r.width for r in rows),sum(r.height for r in rows)), 'white'); y=0
 for r in rows: sheet.paste(r,(0,y)); y+=r.height
 sheet.save(f'zoom/b{start//5+1}.png')
PY

cat > zoom/record.py <<'PY'
import json,sys
items=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]
try: a=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
except FileNotFoundError: a=[]
for s in sys.argv[1:]:
 b,c,*conf=s.split('/')
 it=items[len(a)]
 a.append(dict(item_id=it['item_id'],breathing=next(k for k,v in it['breathing_options'].items() if v==b),accent=next(k for k,v in it['accent_options'].items() if v==c),confidence=conf[0] if conf else 'high',note=''))
open('answers.jsonl','w').write(''.join(json.dumps(x)+'\n' for x in a))
print(len(a))
PY
